These are recorded application events. They are not digital signatures or independently authenticated identities.

Limitations

  • All supplier data, test reports and advisories are synthetic.
  • Documentary eligibility is eligibility for further consideration, not purchase authorization or verified field capability.
  • Extraction supports three labelled UTF-8 text layouts; OCR, arbitrary PDFs and live model evaluation are unperformed.
  • All documents, vendors, tests and advisories in this demonstration are synthetic.
  • The offline package records snapshot status at export time; it has no connection to later workspace revisions.
  • Hashes establish internal consistency only. They do not prove authenticity, claim truth, reviewer identity or procurement authority.
  • The standalone verifier checks archive, source and citation consistency; it does not re-run the scoring or engineering assessment.

Evidence index

Every extracted observation is retained, including rejected and superseded observations. Source bodies remain inert UTF-8 text. Download spreadsheet-safe evidence CSV.
